## Step 2: Data Preparation (Consolidation)

1. Create a script to merge JSON files into a single validated file:

```typescript
// scripts/data-import/events/prepare-events.ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

// Define event data structure
interface EventData {
  name: string;
  date: string | null;
  description: string;
  location: string | null;
  summary?: string;
  category: string[];
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  metadata: {
    source: string;
    dateText: string;
    originalFormat: string;
    keywords: string[];
    fingerprint: string;
  };
  title?: string; // May need to be generated
}

// Load and merge event files
async function mergeEventFiles() {
  const eventsDir = path.join(__dirname, '../processing/events');
  const outputDir = path.join(__dirname, '../output');
  
  // Ensure output directory exists
  if (!fs.existsSync(outputDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });
  }
  
  // Get all JSON files
  const files = fs.readdirSync(eventsDir)
    .filter(file => file.endsWith('.json'));
  
  console.log(`Found ${files.length} event files to process`);
  
  let allEvents: EventData[] = [];
  let issues: {file: string, event: any, issue: string}[] = [];
  
  // Process each file
  for (const file of files) {
    console.log(`Processing ${file}...`);
    const filePath = path.join(eventsDir, file);
    const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
    
    try {
      const events = JSON.parse(fileContent);
      
      // Validate and transform each event
      for (const event of events) {
        // Ensure title exists (use name if needed)
        if (!event.title) {
          event.title = event.name;
        }
        
        // Check for required fields
        if (!event.date) {
          issues.push({file, event, issue: 'Missing date field'});
        }
        
        if (!event.title) {
          issues.push({file, event, issue: 'Missing title field'});
        }
        
        allEvents.push(event);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error processing ${file}:`, error);
      issues.push({file, event: null, issue: `Failed to parse: ${error.message}`});
    }
  }
  
  console.log(`Total events processed: ${allEvents.length}`);
  console.log(`Issues found: ${issues.length}`);
  
  // Write merged events to output file
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(outputDir, 'events.json'),
    JSON.stringify(allEvents, null, 2)
  );
  
  // Write issues report
  if (issues.length > 0) {
    fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(outputDir, 'events-issues.json'),
      JSON.stringify(issues, null, 2)
    );
    console.log(`Issues report written to events-issues.json`);
  }
  
  console.log(`Merged events written to events.json`);
}

mergeEventFiles().catch(console.error);
```

## Step 3: Create Test Import Script

Create a test script that validates the data against the schema and runs a dry-run import:

```typescript
// scripts/data-import/events/test-events-import.ts
import { getXataClient } from '../../../src/db/xata/xata.js';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

interface EventData {
  name?: string;
  title: string;
  date: string | null;
  description: string;
  location: string | null;
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  summary?: string;
  category: string[];
  metadata: {
    source: string;
    dateText: string;
    originalFormat: string;
    keywords: string[];
    fingerprint: string;
  };
}

async function testEventsImport() {
  console.log('Starting test import validation...');
  
  // 1. Load the events data
  const eventsFilePath = path.join(__dirname, '../output/events.json');
  if (!fs.existsSync(eventsFilePath)) {
    console.error('Events file not found:', eventsFilePath);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
  const events: EventData[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(eventsFilePath, 'utf8'));
  console.log(`Loaded ${events.length} events from file`);
  
  // 2. Validate schema compatibility
  const validationResults = {
    total: events.length,
    valid: 0,
    invalid: 0,
    duplicates: 0,
    issues: [] as {title: string, issue: string}[]
  };
  
  const xata = getXataClient();
  const uniqueTitles = new Set<string>();
  
  // 3. Check for duplicates in the input data
  for (const event of events) {
    // Check for required fields
    if (!event.title) {
      validationResults.invalid++;
      validationResults.issues.push({
        title: event.name || 'Unknown',
        issue: 'Missing title field'
      });
      continue;
    }
    
    if (!event.date) {
      validationResults.invalid++;
      validationResults.issues.push({
        title: event.title,
        issue: 'Missing date field'
      });
      continue;
    }
    
    // Check for duplicate titles within the dataset
    if (uniqueTitles.has(event.title)) {
      validationResults.duplicates++;
      validationResults.issues.push({
        title: event.title,
        issue: 'Duplicate title within dataset'
      });
      continue;
    }
    
    uniqueTitles.add(event.title);
    
    // Check for existing records in the database
    try {
      const exists = await xata.db.events
        .filter({ title: event.title })
        .getFirst();
      
      if (exists) {
        validationResults.duplicates++;
        validationResults.issues.push({
          title: event.title,
          issue: 'Already exists in database'
        });
        continue;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error checking for duplicate: ${event.title}`, error);
      validationResults.issues.push({
        title: event.title,
        issue: `Database error: ${error.message}`
      });
      continue;
    }
    
    // Validate date format
    try {
      new Date(event.date);
    } catch (error) {
      validationResults.invalid++;
      validationResults.issues.push({
        title: event.title,
        issue: `Invalid date format: ${event.date}`
      });
      continue;
    }
    
    // All validations passed
    validationResults.valid++;
  }
  
  // 4. Report validation results
  console.log('\nValidation Results:');
  console.log(`Total events: ${validationResults.total}`);
  console.log(`Valid events: ${validationResults.valid}`);
  console.log(`Invalid events: ${validationResults.invalid}`);
  console.log(`Potential duplicates: ${validationResults.duplicates}`);
  
  // Save validation report
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(__dirname, '../output/validation-report.json'),
    JSON.stringify(validationResults, null, 2)
  );
  
  console.log('\nValidation report saved to output/validation-report.json');
  console.log('\nTest import complete.');
}

testEventsImport().catch(console.error);
```

## Step 4: Update run-import.sh

Update the import script to include steps for preparing, testing, and importing events:

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# UFO Intelligence and Sightings Data Import Script
# This script processes UFO intelligence markdown files and sightings data and imports them to Xata

# Set the base directory
BASE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$BASE_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$BASE_DIR/output"
mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR/output"

# Function to prepare events data
prepare_events() {
  echo "=== Preparing Events Data ==="
  
  # Run the preparation script
  echo "Step 1: Merging and validating event files..."
  cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && npx ts-node --esm "$BASE_DIR/events/prepare-events.ts"
  
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Error: Failed to prepare events data."
    return 1
  fi
  
  echo "Events preparation complete."
  echo "Combined events file saved to: $BASE_DIR/output/events.json"
  echo
  return 0
}

# Function to test events import
test_events_import() {
  echo "=== Testing Events Import ==="
  
  # Run the test import script
  echo "Running validation and test import..."
  cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && npx ts-node --esm "$BASE_DIR/events/test-events-import.ts"
  
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Error: Test import failed."
    return 1
  fi
  
  # Display test results summary
  if [ -f "$BASE_DIR/output/validation-report.json" ]; then
    echo "Test import validation complete."
    echo "Please review the validation report at: $BASE_DIR/output/validation-report.json"
  else
    echo "Warning: Validation report not found."
  fi
  
  echo
  return 0
}

# Function to import events data
import_events() {
  echo "=== UFO Intelligence Data Import ==="
  
  # Check if events.json exists
  if [ ! -f "$BASE_DIR/output/events.json" ]; then
    echo "Error: events.json not found. Please prepare the data first."
    return 1
  fi
  
  echo "Step 1: Validating events data..."
  # Run validation/test first
  test_events_import
  
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Validation failed. Fix issues before proceeding."
    return 1
  fi
  
  # Prompt for import options
  echo 
  echo "Step 2: Import Configuration"
  read -p "Would you like to proceed with the import? (y/n): " confirm
  if [[ $confirm != [yY] && $confirm != [yY][eE][sS] ]]; then
    echo "Import cancelled."
    return 0
  fi
  
  read -p "Force import even if duplicates are detected? (y/n): " force_option
  force_arg=""
  if [[ $force_option == [yY] || $force_option == [yY][eE][sS] ]]; then
    force_arg="--force"
  fi

  read -p "Update existing records if duplicates are found? (y/n): " update_option
  update_arg=""
  if [[ $update_option == [yY] || $update_option == [yY][eE][sS] ]]; then
    update_arg="--update"
  fi
  
  # Step 3: Import to Xata
  echo
  echo "Step 3: Importing events data to Xata database..."
  
  # Check if we should use TypeScript or JavaScript
  if [ -f "$BASE_DIR/events/import-events-to-xata.ts" ]; then
    # Use ts-node to run TypeScript file
    echo "Running TypeScript import script..."
    cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && npx ts-node --esm "$BASE_DIR/events/import-events-to-xata.ts" $force_arg $update_arg
  else
    # Fallback to JavaScript
    echo "Running JavaScript import script..."
    node "$BASE_DIR/events/import-events-to-xata.js" $force_arg $update_arg
  fi

  # Check if import was successful
  events_result=$?
  if [ $events_result -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Error: Failed to import events data to Xata."
    return 1
  fi

  echo
  echo "=== Events import process complete ==="
  echo "Check the logs above for details on imported, skipped, and failed entries."
  
  # Show skipped events report if it exists
  if [ -f "$BASE_DIR/events/skipped-events-report.json" ]; then
    echo "Skipped events report available at: $BASE_DIR/events/skipped-events-report.json"
  fi
  
  echo
  return 0
}

# Display the main menu
show_menu() {
  clear
  echo "=== UFO Data Import Tool ==="
  echo "Select an option:"
  echo "1. Prepare events data (merge and validate)"
  echo "2. Test events import (validate against database schema)"
  echo "3. Import events data to Xata"
  echo "4. Full workflow (prepare -> test -> import)"
  echo "5. Import UFO Sightings data"
  echo "q. Quit"
  echo
}

# Main loop
while true; do
  show_menu
  read -p "Enter your choice (1-5, or q): " choice

  case $choice in
    1)
      prepare_events
      read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
      ;;
    2)
      test_events_import
      read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
      ;;
    3)
      import_events
      read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
      ;;
    4)
      # Full workflow
      prepare_events && test_events_import && import_events
      read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
      ;;
    5)
      # Original sightings import function
      import_sightings
      read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
      ;;
    q|Q)
      echo "Exiting."
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Invalid option. Please try again."
      read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
      ;;
  esac
done
```

Now your implementation is ready! Here's how to use the updated system:

## How to Use the Events Import System

1. First, make sure your JSON files are in the right location:
   ```
   scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-1.json
   scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-2.json
   scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-3.json
   scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-4.json
   scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-5.json
   ```

2. Run the import script:
   ```bash
   cd /Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection
   bash scripts/data-import/run-import.sh
   ```

3. From the menu, you can choose:
   - Option 1: Prepare events data (merge JSON files into one)
   - Option 2: Test import (validate against schema without importing)
   - Option 3: Import events data to Xata
   - Option 4: Full workflow (does all steps in sequence)
   - Option 5: Import sightings (from existing code)

## What Each Step Does

1. **Prepare Events Data**:
   - Merges all JSON files from `processing/events/` directory
   - Validates required fields and normalizes data
   - Creates a single output file at `output/events.json`
   - Generates an issues report at `output/events-issues.json`

2. **Test Events Import**:
   - Checks schema compatibility with Xata DB
   - Verifies data validity (dates, required fields)
   - Checks for duplicate records already in the database
   - Generates a validation report at `output/validation-report.json`

3. **Import Events to Xata**:
   - Asks if you want to force import duplicates or update existing records
   - Imports the validated data to Xata
   - Tracks successful imports, duplicates, and errors
   - Generates a skipped events report at `events/skipped-events-report.json`

## Troubleshooting

- If you encounter issues with the ESM imports, make sure to run with the latest Node.js version
- If database connection fails, verify your XATA_API_KEY in the .env file
- Check the validation reports and issues reports for detailed information on any problems

This complete workflow allows you to safely process, validate, and import the JSON event data into your Xata database while ensuring data quality and avoiding duplicates.

```json
        "originalContents": "\n    \n    // Create an import script for Xata\n    const xataImportScript = &#96;\nconst { getXataClient } = require('../../src/db/xata/xata');\nconst events = require('./output/events.json');\n\nasync function importEventsToXata() {\n  const xata = getXataClient();\n  let successCount = 0;\n  let errorCount = 0;\n  \n  console.log(\\&#96;Preparing to import \\${events.length} events to Xata\\&#96;);\n  \n  for (const event of events) {\n    try {\n      // Check if event already exists to avoid duplicates\n      const existingEvents = await xata.db.events\n        .filter({ title: event.title })\n        .getMany();\n        \n      if (existingEvents.length \u003e 0) {\n        console.log(\\&#96;Event already exists: \\${event.title}\\&#96;);\n        continue;\n      }\n      \n      // Insert new event\n      await xata.db.events.create({\n        title: event.title,\n        date: event.date,\n        description: event.description,\n        location: event.location,\n        category: event.category,\n        metadata: event.metadata\n      });\n      \n      successCount++;\n      if (successCount % 10 === 0) {\n        console.log(\\&#96;Imported \\${successCount} events...\\&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\\&#96;Error importing event: \\${event.title}\\&#96;, error);\n      errorCount++;\n    }\n  }\n  \n  console.log(\\&#96;Import complete. Successfully imported \\${successCount} events. \\${errorCount} errors.\\&#96;);\n}\n\nimportEventsToXata()\n  .then(() =\u003e console.log('Done'))\n  .catch(err =\u003e console.error('Import failed:', err));\n&#96;;\n    \n    await writeFileAsync(\n      path.join(__dirname, 'import-events-to-xata.js'),\n      xataImportScript,\n      'utf8'\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Processing complete!');\n    console.log(&#96;Events written to: ${path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, 'events.json')}&#96;);\n    console.log(&#96;CSV written to: ${path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, 'events.csv')}&#96;);\n    console.log(&#96;Import script created: ${path.join(__dirname, 'import-events-to-xata.js')}&#96;);\n    console.log('\\nTo import the events to Xata, run:');",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Extract events from a markdown section - supports multiple bullet point events\nfunction extractEvent(content) {\n  const lines = content.split('\\n').filter(line =\u003e line.trim());\n  \n  if (lines.length \u003c 2) return null;\n  \n  const titleLine = lines[0];\n  const yearMatch = titleLine.match(/^[#\\s-]*([\\d]{3,4})/);\n  \n  if (!yearMatch) return null;\n  \n  const year = yearMatch[1];\n  \n  // Check if the content has bullet points\n  const bulletPointPattern = /^[\\s-]*-\\s+([\\d]{3,4}(?:,\\s+[\\w\\s\\-]+(?:\\s+\\d+)?)?.*)/;\n  const hasBulletPoints = lines.some(line =\u003e bulletPointPattern.test(line));\n  \n  if (hasBulletPoints) {\n    // Process multiple events (bullet points)\n    let events = [];\n    let currentEvent = null;\n    let currentEventLines = [];\n    \n    // Skip the title line\n    for (let i = 1; i \u003c lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i];\n      const bulletMatch = line.match(bulletPointPattern);\n      \n      if (bulletMatch) {\n        // If we have a previous event, process it\n        if (currentEventLines.length \u003e 0) {\n          const eventText = currentEventLines.join('\\n');\n          const dateFromBullet = currentEvent || year;\n          events.push(createEventObject(dateFromBullet, eventText));\n        }\n        \n        // Start a new event\n        currentEvent = bulletMatch[1];\n        currentEventLines = [line.replace(bulletPointPattern, '$1')];\n      } else if (currentEventLines.length \u003e 0) {\n        // Add line to current event\n        currentEventLines.push(line);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Process the last event\n    if (currentEventLines.length \u003e 0) {\n      const eventText = currentEventLines.join('\\n');\n      const dateFromBullet = currentEvent || year;\n      events.push(createEventObject(dateFromBullet, eventText));\n    }\n    \n    return events;\n  } else {\n    // Process as a single event\n    const description = lines.slice(1).join('\\n').trim();\n    return createEventObject(year, description);\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Extract events from a markdown section - supports multiple bullet point events\nfunction extractEvent(content) {\n  const lines = content.split('\\n').filter(line =\u003e line.trim());\n  \n  if (lines.length \u003c 2) return null;\n  \n  const titleLine = lines[0];\n  const yearMatch = titleLine.match(/^[#\\s-]*([\\d]{3,4})/);\n  \n  if (!yearMatch) return null;\n  \n  const year = yearMatch[1];\n  \n  // Check if the content has bullet points\n  const bulletPointPattern = /^[\\s-]*-\\s+([\\d]{3,4}(?:,\\s+[\\w\\s\\-]+(?:\\s+\\d+)?)?.*)/;\n  const hasBulletPoints = lines.some(line =\u003e bulletPointPattern.test(line));\n  \n  if (hasBulletPoints) {\n    // Process multiple events (bullet points)\n    let events = [];\n    let currentEvent = null;\n    let currentEventLines = [];\n    \n    // Skip the title line\n    for (let i = 1; i \u003c lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i];\n      const bulletMatch = line.match(bulletPointPattern);\n      \n      if (bulletMatch) {\n        // If we have a previous event, process it\n        if (currentEventLines.length \u003e 0) {\n          const eventText = currentEventLines.join('\\n');\n          const dateFromBullet = currentEvent || year;\n          events.push(createEventObject(dateFromBullet, eventText));\n        }\n        \n        // Start a new event\n        currentEvent = bulletMatch[1];\n        currentEventLines = [line.replace(bulletPointPattern, '$1')];\n      } else if (currentEventLines.length \u003e 0) {\n        // Add line to current event\n        currentEventLines.push(line);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Process the last event\n    if (currentEventLines.length \u003e 0) {\n      const eventText = currentEventLines.join('\\n');\n      const dateFromBullet = currentEvent || year;\n      events.push(createEventObject(dateFromBullet, eventText));\n    }\n    \n    return events;\n  } else {\n    // Process as a single event\n    const description = lines.slice(1).join('\\n').trim();\n    return createEventObject(year, description);\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Process a markdown file and extract events\nasync function processMarkdownFile(filePath) {\n  try {\n    const content = await readFileAsync(filePath, 'utf8');\n    \n    // Find the beginning of the actual content (skip headers)\n    const contentStartIndex = content.indexOf('## ');\n    if (contentStartIndex === -1) return [];\n    \n    const actualContent = content.substring(contentStartIndex);\n    \n    // Split by markdown headers (## YYYY)\n    const eventSections = actualContent.split(/\\n## /).filter(Boolean);\n    \n    // Process first section differently since it includes the title\n    const firstSectionLines = eventSections[0].split('\\n');\n    const titleLine = firstSectionLines[0];\n    \n    // Check if the first section is actually the document title\n    if (!titleLine.match(/^\\d{3,4}/)) {\n      // This is the document title section, not an event\n      eventSections.shift();\n    }\n    \n    // Extract events from each section\n    return eventSections\n      .map(section =\u003e {\n        // Prepend ## back to each section except the first one\n        const sectionContent = section.startsWith('##') ? section : &#96;## ${section}&#96;;\n        return extractEvent(sectionContent);\n      })\n      .filter(Boolean); // Remove null entries\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error processing file ${filePath}:&#96;, error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Process a markdown file and extract events\nasync function processMarkdownFile(filePath) {\n  try {\n    const content = await readFileAsync(filePath, 'utf8');\n    \n    // Find the beginning of the actual content (skip headers)\n    const contentStartIndex = content.indexOf('## ');\n    if (contentStartIndex === -1) return [];\n    \n    const actualContent = content.substring(contentStartIndex);\n    \n    // Split by markdown headers (## YYYY)\n    const eventSections = actualContent.split(/\\n## /).filter(Boolean);\n    \n    // Process first section differently since it includes the title\n    const firstSectionLines = eventSections[0].split('\\n');\n    const titleLine = firstSectionLines[0];\n    \n    // Check if the first section is actually the document title\n    if (!titleLine.match(/^\\d{3,4}/)) {\n      // This is the document title section, not an event\n      eventSections.shift();\n    }\n    \n    // Extract events from each section\n    return eventSections\n      .flatMap(section =\u003e {\n        // Prepend ## back to each section except the first one\n        const sectionContent = section.startsWith('##') ? section : &#96;## ${section}&#96;;\n        const result = extractEvent(sectionContent);\n        \n        // Handle both single events and arrays of events\n        if (Array.isArray(result)) {\n          return result;\n        } else if (result) {\n          return [result];\n        } else {\n          return [];\n        }\n      }); // flatMap automatically removes empty entries\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error processing file ${filePath}:&#96;, error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Extract event from a markdown section\nfunction extractEvent(content) {\n  const lines = content.split('\\n').filter(line =\u003e line.trim());\n  \n  if (lines.length \u003c 2) return null;\n  \n  const titleLine = lines[0];\n  const dateMatch = titleLine.match(/^[#\\s-]*([\\d]{3,4}(?:,\\s+[\\w]+(?:\\s+\\d+)?)?)/);\n  \n  if (!dateMatch) return null;\n  \n  const dateText = dateMatch[1];\n  const description = lines.slice(1).join('\\n').trim();\n  \n  return {\n    title: &#96;UFO Event ${dateText}&#96;,\n    date: parseDateFromText(dateText),\n    description,\n    location: extractLocation(description),\n    category: ['historical', 'ufo-sighting'],\n    metadata: {\n      source: 'UFOs and Intelligence: A Timeline',\n      dateText,\n      originalFormat: 'markdown'\n    }\n  };\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Generate a unique fingerprint for an event to help with de-duplication\nfunction generateEventFingerprint(dateText, description, location) {\n  // Skip if empty\n  if (!dateText || !description) return '';\n  \n  // Extract key identifying information\n  const year = dateText.match(/\\d{3,4}/) ? dateText.match(/\\d{3,4}/)[0] : dateText;\n  \n  // Take the first 50 characters of description, lowercase and remove special chars\n  const descriptionSnippet = description\n    .substring(0, 50)\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[^\\w\\s]/g, '')\n    .trim();\n  \n  // Include location information if available for more uniqueness\n  const locationPart = location \n    ? &#96;_${location.split(',')[0].trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^\\w\\s]/g, '').substring(0, 20).replace(/\\s+/g, '_')}&#96;\n    : '';\n  \n  // Add a randomized component to reduce duplicate likelihood for generic descriptions\n  const randomId = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000).toString().padStart(4, '0');\n  \n  // Combine all parts for a more unique fingerprint\n  return &#96;${year}_${descriptionSnippet.substring(0, 30).replace(/\\s+/g, '_')}${locationPart}_${randomId}&#96;;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Generate a unique fingerprint for an event to help with de-duplication\nfunction generateEventFingerprint(dateText, description, location) {\n  // Skip if empty\n  if (!dateText || !description) return '';\n  \n  // Extract key identifying information\n  const year = dateText.match(/\\d{3,4}/) ? dateText.match(/\\d{3,4}/)[0] : dateText;\n  \n  // Take the first 50 characters of description, lowercase and remove special chars\n  const descriptionSnippet = description\n    .substring(0, 50)\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[^\\w\\s]/g, '')\n    .trim();\n  \n  // Include location information if available for more uniqueness\n  const locationPart = location \n    ? &#96;_${location.split(',')[0].trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^\\w\\s]/g, '').substring(0, 20).replace(/\\s+/g, '_')}&#96;\n    : '';\n  \n  // Add a randomized component to reduce duplicate likelihood for generic descriptions\n  const randomId = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000).toString().padStart(4, '0');\n  \n  // Combine all parts for a more unique fingerprint\n  return &#96;${year}_${descriptionSnippet.substring(0, 30).replace(/\\s+/g, '_')}${locationPart}_${randomId}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n// Create or get an event record by title\nasync function createOrGetEvent(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  event: EventData\n): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Try to find existing event by title\n    const existingEvent = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({ title: event.title })\n      .getFirst();\n    \n    if (existingEvent) {\n      return existingEvent.id;\n    }\n    \n    // Parse date if available\n    let eventDate: Date | undefined = undefined;\n    if (event.date) {\n      try {\n        // Handle various date formats\n        eventDate = new Date(event.date);\n        if (isNaN(eventDate.getTime())) {\n          eventDate = undefined;\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        // Invalid date format, ignore\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Create new event record\n    const newEvent = await xata.db.events.create({\n      title: event.title,\n      name: event.title,\n      description: event.description,\n      location: event.location,\n      date: eventDate,\n      metadata: { details: event.details }\n    });\n    \n    return newEvent.id;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error creating/getting event record for ${event.title}:&#96;, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}",
```

```json
        "contents": "import { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\nimport { ValidatedUAPSighting, UAPSightingSchema } from './uap-sighting';\n\n/**\n * Fetch sightings within a specified time range\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getSightingsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n): Promise\u003cValidatedUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get sightings within date range\n    const sightingsRecords = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "import { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",
```

```json
        "contents": "\n\nasync function importEventsToXata(\n\toptions: {\n\t\tforceImport?: boolean;\n\t\tskipDuplicates?: boolean;\n\t} = {},\n) {\n\tconst xata = getXataClient();\n\tlet successCount = 0;\n\tlet errorCount = 0;\n\tlet duplicateCount = 0;\n\tlet skippedCount = 0;\n\n\t// Set default options\n\tconst skipDuplicates = options.skipDuplicates ??         "contents": "\n\nasync function importEventsToXata(options = {}) {\n  const xata = getXataClient();\n  let successCount = 0;\n  let errorCount = 0;\n  let duplicateCount = 0;\n  let skippedCount = 0;\n  \n  // Default options\n  const skipDuplicates = options.skipDuplicates ?? true;\n  const forceImport = options.forceImport ?? false;\n  \n  console.log(&#96;Preparing to import ${events.length} events to Xata&#96;);\n  console.log(forceImport ? \"FORCE IMPORT MODE: Will import even if duplicates are detected\" : \n             (skipDuplicates ? \"Normal mode: Will skip duplicates\" : \"Will check duplicates but import anyway\"));\n  \n  // Tracking for skipped events\n  const skippedEvents = [];\n  \n  for (const event of events) {\n    try {\n      // Skip events without required data\n      if (!event.date) {\n        console.log(&#96;Event lacking date, skipping: ${event.title}&#96;);\n        skippedEvents.push({\n          title: event.title,\n          reason: \"Missing required date field\"\n        });\n        skippedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n      \n      // Enhanced duplicate detection\n      const { isDuplicate, method } = await checkForDuplicates(xata, event);\n      \n      if (isDuplicate \u0026\u0026 skipDuplicates \u0026\u0026 !forceImport) {\n        console.log(&#96;Duplicate event detected: ${event.title} (method: ${method})&#96;);\n        skippedEvents.push({\n          title: event.title,\n          reason: &#96;Duplicate (detected by: ${method})&#96;\n        });\n        duplicateCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n      \n      // Truncate the description if it's too long\n      const truncatedDescription = truncateToByteLimit(event.description);\n      \n      // Insert new event with all fields\n      await xata.db.events.create({\n        title: event.title,\n        name: event.name || event.title,\n        date: event.date,\n        description: truncatedDescription,\n        location: event.location,\n        latitude: event.latitude,\n        longitude: event.longitude,\n        summary: event.summary,\n        category: event.category,\n        metadata: event.metadata\n      });",
```

```diff
+ function truncateToByteLimit(text: string | undefined, byteLimit = 200 * 1024): string {
+ 	if (!text) return "";
+ 	
+ 	const buffer = Buffer.from(text, 'utf8');
+ 	if (buffer.byteLength &lt;= byteLimit) {
+ 		return text;
+ 	}
+ 	
+ 	// Truncate the buffer to the byte limit
+ 	const truncatedBuffer = buffer.slice(0, byteLimit);
+ 	const truncatedText = truncatedBuffer.toString('utf8');
+ 	
+ 	// If truncation breaks a character, trim it properly
+ 	const lastValidChar = truncatedText.length;
+ 	return truncatedText.substring(0, lastValidChar) + "... (truncated)";
+ }
```

The function `truncateToByteLimit` is defined twice with slightly different signatures and implementations:
1. The first one takes `text: string | undefined` and has a default byte limit of `200 * 1024`
2. The second one takes `text: string` (no undefined) and has a default byte limit of `204800` (which is the same value, just hardcoded)

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The user is asking if they can use a path alias instead of the relative import paths in their TypeScript code. Let me analyze what they might be referring to:

1. Currently the imports look like:
```typescript
import { getXataClient } from "../../../src/db/xata";
```

2. There are linter errors indicating:
```
Relative import paths need explicit file extensions in ECMAScript imports when '--moduleResolution' is 'node16' or 'nodenext'. Consider adding an extension to the import path.
```

3. Path aliases in TypeScript projects are typically configured in the tsconfig.json file using the "paths" compiler option to create shortcuts for imports.

Let me look at what the correct approach might be:

a) They could add the file extension to fix the linter error:
```typescript
import { getXataClient } from "../../../src/db/xata.ts"; // or .js
```

b) Or they might have a path alias configured in their tsconfig.json, which would allow them to use something like:
```typescript
import { getXataClient } from "@/db/xata"; // or something similar
```

I should check if there's a tsconfig.json in their project to see if path aliases are already configured. Since I don't have direct access to that file, I'll respond based on general best practices for handling TypeScript imports with path aliases.</details></think>

_**Agent**_

Yes, you can use path aliases instead of relative paths. This would help fix your linter errors about missing file extensions in ESM imports and make your imports cleaner.

First, check if your project already has path aliases configured in tsconfig.json. If it does, you can replace:
```typescript
import { getXataClient } from "../../../src/db/xata";
```

With something like:
```typescript
import { getXataClient } from "@/db/xata";
```

If you need to set up path aliases, add or update the "paths" option in your tsconfig.json:

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "baseUrl": ".",
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["src/*"]
    }
  }
}
```

This will let you use `@/` to reference files from your src directory, making imports more readable and maintainable.
